### ⚠️ The Quarantine Protocol ⚠️
**READ BEFORE SUBMITTING:** The Language Crucible is a zero-execution containment zone designed for structural stress-testing. 

By submitting this Pull Request, you acknowledge the following constraints:
- [ ] **Zero Execution:** I have not included any executable scripts, compiled binaries, or active build steps (`npm`, `pip`, `make`, etc.).
- [ ] **Pure Structure:** This submission is intended strictly as a structural parser benchmark (e.g., language structural signature hits, edge-case syntax, heavy nesting, uncompilable legacy code).
- [ ] **No Malicious Payloads:** I have not intentionally obfuscated active malware, reverse shells, or typosquatting execution traps.
- [ ] **Permission Stripped:** I understand that all executable permission bits will be automatically stripped from these files upon merge.
